name: Jasch Industries Ltd
tagline: Small-cap PU/PVC synthetic-leather manufacturer (post-2024 demerger of its gauging business) with a genuine, community-verified live inflection - a new Kia OEM supply contract, capacity expansion, and explicit domestic market-share gains from larger rival Mayur Uniquoters - already re-rated 44-56% in weeks, at just Rs 201 Cr market cap
business_overview: Jasch Industries (Sonepat, Haryana, Garg family-run) has historically run two disparate divisions - PVC/PU coated-fabric (synthetic leather, similar to Mayur Uniquoters) and industrial electronic-gauge manufacturing. The gauge division was demerged into Jasch Gauging Technologies Ltd (separately listed Feb 2024), leaving Jasch Industries focused on coated fabrics/synthetic leather, clients including Puma, Red Tape, Bata, and now automotive OEMs. Doing a Rs 28 Cr capex to supply Kia (signed a supply agreement Nov 2024, already shipping). (Source: external-lead, @StocksAndStoics, untrusted X triage, first_seen 2026-09-04 - grouped with Mayur/Premier Polyfilm as an 'artificial-leather trio' up 50-70% on the auto-demand cycle.)
fundamentals_table: Revenue +26% YoY, net profit +232% YoY (Mar 2025 quarter)
+44% in 2 days (late May 2026), +56% in the following month per forum posts
fundamentals_narrative: A textbook 'weak trailing average, strong live inflection' small-cap case: 5yr sales growth of only 11.2%/yr, but Q4FY25 delivered +26% revenue and +232% profit growth, driven by a real, named catalyst - a new OEM supply contract with Kia (signed Nov 2024, already shipping, Rs 28 Cr capacity-expansion capex underway). The community independently worked the math: Kia's ~2.5 lakh vehicles/year at ~10-12 metres of leather cloth each implies ~25-30 lakh metres of incremental demand, worth an estimated Rs 80-100 Cr against a prior-year revenue base of just Rs 170 Cr - a potentially transformative single contract for a company this size. A trusted user (Prabhat_Mohanty) independently confirmed the improvement looks genuinely fundamental (topline-driven), not a one-off forex gain like the community observed at peer Mayur Uniquoters' concurrent results. Company also stands to benefit from the UK-India FTA (implemented July 2026), though the tariff benefit likely accrues to customers rather than Jasch's own margin per community discussion. Genuine information-scarcity risk: the company does not hold con-calls.
technical_read: Not pulled - fundamentals/community catalyst math was decisive; stock has already run up sharply (+44% in 2 days, +56% in a month) ahead of confirmation.
sentiment_summary: 30-post thread spanning 2016-2026 (originally about the now-demerged gauging division's value-unlocking potential). Post-demerger (2024) activity has focused entirely on the coated-fabric business: PE/margin comparison vs Mayur (2024), the Kia contract build-out and community revenue math (Apr-May 2025), and a strong Q4FY25 result confirmation, followed by a sharp, community-noted price re-rating in mid-2026.

Prabhat_Mohanty (trusted) confirmed in Jun 2026 that Jasch's improvement is 'more fundamental' than a peer's forex-driven result, specifically citing Q4 topline strength and the PU capacity expansion as a genuine positive demand signal, while flagging the lack of con-calls as an information-flow risk.
